title: RCF Kapurthala to Roll Out First LHB Coach Rake for Bangladesh

blocks.content: The Rail Coach Factory (RCF) at Kapurthala in Punjab is scheduled to roll out its first rake of 19 Linke Hofmann Busch (LHB) broad gauge passenger coaches for Bangladesh Railway on 12 August 2026. The rake is part of a 2024 export contract executed through RITES Ltd. for 200 broad gauge passenger coaches in seven variants.

items: Linke Hofmann Busch coaches are widely used in Indian Railways for broad gauge passenger services.
RITES Ltd. is a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Railways.
European Standard EN 15227 deals with railway vehicle crashworthiness.
Bangladesh Railway uses broad gauge coaches on several intercity and long-distance routes.
